entries.title_en: Police effectiveness against street crime in Jakarta and major cities

entries.title_en: Food inflation outpaces official growth narrative
entries.title_zh: 食品通胀超越官方增长叙事

entries.title_en: APBN deficit fuels rupiah weakness narrative

entries.title_en: Corruption allegations linking PLN to DPR members and officials
